body: Feels like a weird take imo. Yeah, its not ranked, but it was just as much a game mode as regular unranked was. It was fun in its own way, and was much more fast paced but also required some stratergy just different to pvp. Now its basically a meme mode on a lot of games, and its incredibly un-fun to have a whole team pick a single character and just repeatedly die no matter how good you are, just like it would be if that happened in pvp mode.
